article.headline: Senegal chases first win under Vieira against Ethiopia in AFCON qualifier
article.summary: Senegal faces Ethiopia on Tuesday in Bahir Dar in the second matchday of the 2027 AFCON qualifiers, seeking Patrick Vieira's first victory after drawing 1-1 with Mozambique.
article.body:
Senegal dominated their opening match against Mozambique but could not convert chances in a 1-1 draw, Nicolas Jackson's early goal cancelled by Geny Catamo's first-half equalizer. Now the Lions of Teranga travel to Bahir Dar International Stadium to face Ethiopia, who fell 1-0 to Sudan in the qualifying opener when Mohamed Eisa scored in the 86th minute.

Viera has made intensity and clinical finishing his priorities. "We'll continue to play with more intensity and capitalise on the chances we've created," he told reporters. "It's important for us to play a good match, a complete match." Despite the long journey to Ethiopia, Vieira said the team will be "competitive in terms of tactics, physical condition, and mental strength." Senegal will be without Sadio Mané due to a physical issue but retain Nicolas Jackson, Kalidou Koulibaly, Idrissa Gana Gueye, and Pape Matar Sarr. Saudi Pro League defender Malang Sarr is set for his Senegal debut.

Ethiopia coach Yohannes Sahilu stressed focus after his strikers missed chances against Sudan. "We should be focused on the game. We should avoid any costly mistakes. We should finish off the chances we create," he said. Bahir Dar, which has hosted the Waliyas only once in five years, is considered a fortress where Ethiopia beat Ivory Coast in 2021 AFCON qualifying.

After matchday one, Sudan leads Group J with three points. Senegal and Mozambique have one point each, while Ethiopia has none. The top two teams will qualify directly for the tournament in Kenya, Tanzania, and Uganda.

article.headline: Morocco faces Lesotho in AFCON qualifier at South African stadium
article.summary: Morocco plays Lesotho on Tuesday at Free State Toyota Stadium in Bloemfontein, South Africa, in their second Africa Cup of Nations 2027 qualifying match, with captain Achraf Hakimi returning after suspension.
article.body:
Issa Diop welcomed the challenge ahead of Morocco's clash with Lesotho in South Africa, calling it his first away match in Africa. "It's my first time in South Africa. It will also be my first away match in Africa. It's something new for me, and I'm really looking forward to taking on this challenge," the defender said at the pre-match press conference.

Morocco, ranked Africa's number one, arrives in Bloemfontein after opening their qualifying campaign with a 2-0 victory over Gabon in Rabat. The Atlas Lions seek another positive result to build momentum in the AFCON 2027 qualifying rounds. Defender Nayef Aguerd remained in Morocco following recent surgery, with the coaching staff managing his gradual return to fitness rather than rushing him into competitive action.

The fixture takes place at the Free State Toyota Stadium because Lesotho does not have a CAF-approved stadium. Morocco's squad includes World Cup quarter-finalists such as Real Madrid's Brahim Diaz, Paris Saint-Germain's Achraf Hakimi, Bayern Munich's Ismael Saibari, and new Manchester City signing Ayyoub Bouaddi. Hakimi and Saibari return after missing the opening match due to suspension.

Diop stressed that discipline and focus will prove crucial as Morocco look to secure victory in an away fixture. "We know that away games in Africa are tough. I hope that tomorrow we'll put in a top-class performance and win the match," he said.

article.summary: Oscar-winning actress Zoe Saldaña told People that her demanding lead role in Taylor Sheridan's CIA drama 'Lioness' is all she can handle, with Season 3 having ended on Paramount+ in September.
article.body:
Saldaña described the workload as overwhelming: she is first on the call sheet, arriving first and leaving last, and prepares for months before other cast members begin their prep work. "I'm number one on the call sheet. I am first one in, last one out," she explained to People. "I am prepping months before anybody ever is able to prep. So it's already a lot of work for me."

For Saldaña, the role matters because Sheridan created a character not defined by gender. She praised Sheridan for understanding her as an actress, noting he knows she is "honest," "tough as nails," and "vocal and opinionated." Despite the grueling demands, she expressed gratitude for their three-season partnership, saying Sheridan recognizes her reliability.

Season 3 concluded with Joe McNamara's CIA career becoming intensely personal, putting her family and marriage under pressure while she became a target. Saldaña told Entertainment Weekly before the season aired that she had doubted whether she could manage the role's demands. "It was very demanding, I'm not gonna lie," she said. "I didn't even know if I was gonna be able to pull it off."

Saldaña also expressed uncertainty about the show's future. "I don't know if we're able to go to a Season 4," she told People. Paramount+ has not yet greenlit the series for a fourth season as of her interview.

article.summary: Comedian Matt Rife says his 20.3 million TikTok followers and reported $40-50 million net worth came from viral crowd work clips on the platform, after years struggling in Los Angeles's traditional comedy circuit earned him only $40-60 thousand annually.
article.body:
Matt Rife earned between $40,000 and $60,000 annually in Los Angeles before discovering TikTok, a salary that qualified him as "very low income" by the city's cost of living standards. He moved to Ohio to Los Angeles expecting to follow the traditional path: become a regular at famous comedy clubs like the Laugh Factory, Comedy Store, or the Improv, where talent scouts would spot him and offer television or sitcom roles.

Instead, early success on MTV's "Wild 'N Out" faded, leaving him at professional "rock bottom." That's when social media changed everything. Giancarlo Stanton has not played since April 24, when a calf strain began what became a two-injury ordeal. He suffered his initial calf injury in April, then injured his other calf while attempting to return. After weeks of speculation about whether his season had ended, the Yankees activated him Tuesday, according to MLB Network's Jon Morosi.

Stanton's return matters for October baseball. Home runs carry extra weight in postseason play, and the Yankees get one of baseball's best home run hitters back, even if limited. Manager Aaron Boone said Stanton would likely be used primarily as a pinch hitter off the bench rather than in a starting role.

On Monday, the day before the roster decision, Stanton took five at-bats in live batting practice at an empty Yankee Stadium against pitchers Ryan Weathers, Elmer Rodríguez, and prospect Kyle Carr. He walked once, struck out twice, and hit two ground balls. Boone watched the entire session and said beforehand it would be important for determining the final roster call. The slugger showed no visible discomfort during the workout, running curves in the outfield and taking leads off first base, though he was not going full-speed, a purposeful approach to avoid further injury.

Stanton does not typically use rehab assignments after injuries, preferring instead to find his timing in the cage. This approach may help him contribute immediately for the Yankees, as his bat could be ready without a lengthy minor league stint.

article.body:
When Adam Sandler performed "The Chanukah Song" on Saturday Night Live in 1994, he included a line about Winkler's iconic character: "Guess who eats together at the Carnegie Deli? Bowzer from Sha Na Na and Arthur Fonzarelli." That shoutout prompted Winkler to call Sandler directly to thank him.

The unexpected connection changed Winkler's career path. Years later, when Sandler was casting The Waterboy, he offered Winkler the role of Coach Klein without requiring him to audition. "All of a sudden, I got picked to be the coach. And I didn't have to audition," Winkler told Forbes. "So the man is brilliant."

In The Waterboy, Winkler's college football coach character recruits Sandler's waterboy to play on his struggling team. The 1998 comedy became one of Sandler's most popular films. Winkler noted that college football players have told him they watch the film on team buses heading to games.

During production, Sandler called Winkler at 11:30 p.m. asking for an emergency favor: an actor hadn't shown up. Winkler drove to the park in Los Angeles, received makeup until 3:30 a.m., and filmed the scene. For his unscheduled night work, Winkler said he received a cookie and didn't even get to keep his wardrobe.

news.og_desc: Who is ready for October baseball? Well, we won't need to wait for the start of a new month in order to get some postseason action, since the MLB playoffs begin Tuesday. That's when all four of the Wild Card Series presented by AbbVie will get underway.

article.headline: MLB Wild Card Series kicks off with four games on Tuesday
article.summary: The MLB playoffs begin Tuesday, September 29, with all four Wild Card Series matchups getting underway, including Phillies vs. Braves at 2:00 PM ET, White Sox vs. Astros at 5:00 PM ET, Red Sox vs. Yankees at 8:00 PM ET, and Cubs vs. Padres at 10:00 PM ET.
article.body:
Four Wild Card Series games tip off Tuesday as October baseball arrives early in the season. The slate begins with Phillies vs. Braves at 2:00 PM ET and concludes with Cubs vs. Padres at 10:00 PM ET, with White Sox vs. Astros and Red Sox vs. Yankees filling the afternoon and evening windows.

The postseason debut carries high stakes for teams seeking to advance. The White Sox face particular pressure: the vast majority of their hitters are getting their first taste of postseason play after several key contributors slumped down the stretch. Munetaka Murakami and Colson Montgomery posted two of the lowest batting averages in the Majors since August 1, despite their strong early-season performances. For the Astros, Yordan Alvarez enters as the American League MVP frontrunner, hitting .400 with four home runs and a 1.300 OPS across his last 11 games before the playoffs.

The Phillies will turn to Jesus Luzardo as their opener despite his limited recent work—he has thrown just one inning since September 7 due to injury. Luzardo owns a career-best 2.85 ERA and posted a complete-game shutout with nine strikeouts against the Braves in his last full outing. The Braves counter with Chris Sale, who at 36 years old posted a 2.16 ERA this season while averaging 96.2 mph on his fastball, his hardest velocity since his rookie year.

All four Wild Card Series will air on Peacock and NBCSN, with select games on NBC. Game 2 matchups follow on Wednesday, with Game 3s, if necessary, scheduled for Thursday.

article.headline: Madagascar and Tanzania seek first points in AFCON 2027 qualifying after opening defeats
article.summary: Madagascar and Tanzania face each other on Tuesday, September 29, in Group L of the 2027 Africa Cup of Nations qualifiers, both searching for their first points after losing their opening matches.
article.body:
Both teams enter Matchday 2 without a single point, making the encounter in Morocco one of the most consequential of their campaigns so far. Madagascar lost 2-1 to Nigeria despite taking an early lead through Ehsan Kari in the 16th minute, while Tanzania suffered a 2-0 home defeat to Guinea-Bissau in Zanzibar. Tanzania's coach Miguel Ángel Gamondi acknowledged his team dominated possession but failed to convert chances into goals, challenging his players to improve their efficiency in the final third.

The stakes differ significantly between the two teams. Tanzania has already qualified for AFCON 2027 as one of three co-hosts alongside Kenya and Uganda, so the qualifiers serve primarily as competitive preparation. For Madagascar, however, the situation is urgent. Only the highest-ranked non-host nation in Group L will earn the group's additional qualifying spot, meaning Nigeria, Guinea-Bissau, and Madagascar must compete for one berth. After Matchday 1, Guinea-Bissau and Nigeria both held three points, widening the gap.

A second consecutive defeat would significantly damage Madagascar's qualification prospects in a six-match campaign. Tanzania's automatic qualification removes the pressure of results, allowing them to experiment and build form. The match kicks off at 4:00pm East Africa Time on Tuesday in Meknès, Morocco.
